# 0.5.12

## 本次更新

- 推荐页刷新失败时保留已有作品，可直接重试；旧的分页结果不再覆盖新加载的内容。
- 网页会话恢复后自动重新加载推荐，不再要求手动重试。
- 启动时自动补齐缺失的认证 Cookie，减少“无法确认个性化推荐”的误报。
- 登录校验遇到挑战页时改用真实 WebView 复核，不再直接判定无法确认。
- 收藏按钮调整为更克制的设计：卡片心形缩小并使用主题色，详情页收藏按钮与日期信息并排显示。

## Changes (English)

- Keep existing feed items when refresh fails, with a retry action; stale page results no longer overwrite freshly loaded content.
- Reload recommendations automatically after the web session recovers, without manual retries.
- Backfill missing auth cookies on startup to reduce false "cannot confirm personalized recommendations" states.
- Verify challenge pages in a real WebView during session checks instead of giving up immediately.
- Tone down favourite controls: a smaller theme-colored heart on cards, and the detail-page action moved onto the date row.
